(Bucci)Veṅkaṭācārya
alias Kirīṭi Veṅkaṭācārya. (18th Cent.), son of Aṇṇayācārya of Tirumala Bukkapaṭṭaṇam Śrīśaila family of Surapuram an. grandson of Śrīnivāsa Tātācārya; was also disciple of his uncle Śrīnivāśācārya. Lived in the court of king Veṅkaṭanāyaka, son of Bahiri Pāni (soma?). He belonged to Śaṭhamarṣaṇa gotra.
See Rama Raju, Cont. of Andhra to Skt. Lit. p.. 580-87.
